messages:
luca_new: hi team, quick onboarding Qs. 1) i got a yubikey in the kit but the provisioning doc points to an internal app i can't access yet. who provisions hardware tokens? 2) i have to fill out the SOC2 vendor questionnaire for my previous employer any tips on what to put for data residency questions? 3) saw a phishing sim notice but i think i clicked it by accident — is there a retake or remediation flow? tagging @dana_peopleops and @anita_security

Dana_peopleops: welcome luca! :wave: for yubikeys we coordinate with IT to register the key to your Okta account. @rory_it will send a registration link. for SOC2 vendor Qs, legal-ops usually reviews prior to submission if it's sensitive. we'll patch you through.

rory_it: hey Luca  sending the one-time provisioning link now. when you get it, plug the YubiKey in, open Chrome, go to Okta -> Security -> MFA -> Add authenticator -> Security Key, and follow the browser prompts. if the browser blocks, try Safari on macs or make sure extensions are disabled.

luca_new: got the link, thanks. do i need to generate an SSH cert with the YubiKey now or is that separate?

anita_security: SSH certs are separate. Yubikey can hold a PIV cert for SSH if you want hardware-backed keys. default onboarding uses Okta passkeys + phone MFA, hardware key is optional but recommended for high-priv roles. if you want PIV+SSH help ping @rory_it and we can walk you through `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_yubi -o` and the PKCS11 steps.

luca_new: noted. about the SOC2 vendor questionnaire  im not sure what to answer for "cross-border data transfers" since my previous company used global infra. is saying "global infra with contractual controls" sufficient?

legal-ops: hi Luca  for vendor questionnaires, keep answers factual and avoid proprietary detail. "Global infrastructure with contractual data transfer agreements (standard contractual clauses) and encryption at rest/in transit" is a good baseline. if they ask for evidence, route them to our SOC2 pack or we'll prepare a redacted excerpt. DM me the questionnaire if you want a pre-review.

luca_new: thanks, i'll DM it. last bit: phishing sim retake policy? i clicked a simulated link and got the micro-training popup; curious if that affects my probation or access.

anita_security: internal policy: failing a phishing sim triggers a required micro-training and a note in your training tracker, not an access penalty for new hires. repeated failures (3+ within 90 days) escalate to your manager for a coaching touchpoint. there is no formal "retake"; the goal is remediation. complete the micro-training within 48h to mark it completed.

compliance-bot: PhishSim: user luca_new completed interactive micro-training at 1782501330. Training completion recorded.

rory_it: YubiKey registration shows successful at 1782501355. if you want PIV SSH, i'll open a ticket and we can schedule 15m.

Dana_peopleops: filed a legal pre-review request for the vendor questionnaire at 1782501402. expect feedback in 1 business day. also FYI new hires must finish "Security Quickstart" and "Privacy & SOC2 Essentials" in Okta Learn within 72h.

luca_new: awesome, appreciate the rapid help. one tiny follow-up: is it okay to use personal phone for Okta Verify or should i request a company device?

anita_security: personal phones are allowed for Okta Verify but consider platform protections (screen lock, OS updates). if you prefer a company phone for MFA, request via People Ops and we'll allocate if available.

legal-ops: just saw the DM with the questionnaire. i'll leave inline comments on ambiguous items and suggest a redacted evidence bundle.

luca_new: all set for now, thanks again everyone!
